about: The secreta of the formulary “10th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Let the sacred gifts be offered to You, O Lord, Who have given them to be presented for the honor of Your name, for in them You have given us a remedy for all our ills. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,
